name: postgresql
displayName: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server
description: Managed PostgreSQL with high availability, auto-scaling, and intelligent performance

roleAssignments.note: Use Entra ID auth with managed identity instead of passwords. Configure via serverParameters: azure.extensions = 'AZURE_AD'

defaultConfig.note: Burstable B1ms for dev (~$12/month). General Purpose D2s_v3 for production (~$100/month). Use Entra ID auth with managed identity.

integration.authNote: Use Entra ID authentication with managed identity. No passwords stored. Requires enabling Azure AD extension on the server and setting the managed identity as AD admin.

appSettings.name: AZURE_POSTGRESQL_USER
appSettings.description: Managed identity client ID (used as username for Entra auth)

sdkInitPattern.python:
import asyncpg
from azure.identity.aio import DefaultAzureCredential

credential = DefaultAzureCredential(managed_identity_client_id=os.environ.get('AZURE_CLIENT_ID'))
token = await credential.get_token('https://ossrdbms-aad.database.windows.net/.default')

conn = await asyncpg.connect(
    host=os.environ['AZURE_POSTGRESQL_HOST'],
    database=os.environ['AZURE_POSTGRESQL_DATABASE'],
    user=os.environ['AZURE_POSTGRESQL_USER'],
    password=token.token,
    ssl='require'
)

migrations.note: Use Alembic (Python) or node-pg-migrate (TypeScript) for schema management. Run migrations in postdeploy hook.
